title: finite support compositor existence
statement:
Let $R$ be a finite commutative ring, and $X,Y,Z$ Noetherian schemes (locally Noetherian and quasi-compact). Let $f:X	o Y$ and $g:Y	o Z$ be quasi-compact morphisms, and let $c_f,c_g,c_h$ be compactifications of $f,g,fg$. In the ordinary intrinsic constant-ring categories $\Dctf(T,R)$ of [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], suppose each specified compact-support functor preserves $\Dctf$. Denote its restriction by $F_f,F_g,F_h$, and the bounded-below etale-to-intrinsic comparison by $
u_T$ and its specified compact-support site isomorphism by $s_c$ [def-sp-adjoint-compositor-data]. There exists a natural isomorphism $\alpha:F_g\circ F_f\simeq F_h$ (first apply $F_f$, then $F_g$). For every bounded-below etale complex $L$ on $X$ for which $
u_X L$ belongs to $\Dctf$, its ambient component equals $F_g(s_{c_f}(L));s_{c_g}(F_f^{et}L);
u_Z(\alpha^{et}(L));s_{c_h}(L)^{-1}$. Here $\alpha^{et}$ is exactly the normalized proper/open compact-support compositor on the specified three compactifications. No exceptional adjunction or coefficient-change equation is asserted.

proof.text: Use finite-ring constructible derived origin on each Noetherian scheme. Exact tensor-compatible comparison and its fully faithful unit reflect finite Tor amplitude, so the origin equivalence restricts to the intrinsic Dctf objects.

Transport the ordinary proper/open compact-support compositor through the fully faithful origin comparison and the given support site isomorphisms. The three supplied closure proofs merely restrict its endpoints; finite compact-site coherence identifies the component on each etale witness with the word in the statement.

Transport the inverse in the same way. Naturality and the two inverse identities follow by full faithfulness. For any bounded-below witness whose comparison is intrinsic Dctf, reflect bounded constructibility and Tor amplitude, and use naturality along its origin isomorphism to obtain the same normalization.

theorem finiteSupportCompositor_exists
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R]
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian Z]
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiCompact g]
    (cf : Compactification f) (cg : Compactification g) (ch : Compactification (f ≫ g))
    (hFf : ∀ M : spFiniteConstructibleTorCategory X R,
      spFiniteConstructibleTor Y R ((reductionCompactSupport R cf.i cf.g).obj M.obj))
    (hFg : ∀ M : spFiniteConstructibleTorCategory Y R,
      spFiniteConstructibleTor Z R ((reductionCompactSupport R cg.i cg.g).obj M.obj))
    (hFh : ∀ M : spFiniteConstructibleTorCategory X R,
      spFiniteConstructibleTor Z R ((reductionCompactSupport R ch.i ch.g).obj M.obj)) :
    ∃ alpha : finiteAdjointSupport R cf hFf ⋙ finiteAdjointSupport R cg hFg ≅
      finiteAdjointSupport R ch hFh,
    ∀ (E : DerivedCategory.Plus
        (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} R))))
      (hE : spFiniteConstructibleTor X R ((reductionSite R X).obj E.obj)),
      (alpha.hom.app ⟨(reductionSite R X).obj E.obj, hE⟩).hom =
        (reductionCompactSupport R cg.i cg.g).map
            ((finiteAdjointSiteSupportIso R cf).hom.app E) ≫
          (finiteAdjointSiteSupportIso R cg).hom.app
            ((Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlus
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} R)) cf).obj E) ≫
          (reductionSite R Z).map
            ((coherenceEtaleCompositor (ULift.{u + 1, u} R) cf cg ch).hom.app E).hom ≫
          (finiteAdjointSiteSupportIso R ch).inv.app E
